name: Movoa
summary: Official SDK for Movoa (movoa.ai), the AI video generator with sound.
description: Unlimited AI video generator with sound: on paid plans the tenth take of a shot costs what the first did, and your first clip is free to make right now. Official Swift SDK for Movoa (movoa.ai): turn a prompt, or a photo as the first frame, into a video clip with sound on your Movoa account and get back the URL of the finished file.
